overview.description: Whether you've mastered DNA manipulation or just want to make GFP, a working knowledge of protein mechanics serves you well. This theory primer covers enough to produce, purify and observe proteins - read more widely for the deep end.
objectives: describe protein structure levels and folding
connect sequence to expression and purification choices
understand disulphide bonds and misfolding risks
